04 / GOOD QUESTIONS

A few things
you might be
wondering.

Will this replace my team?+

Your team keeps taking calls as usual. NoringAI is the backup for calls that go unanswered, with the handoff set up around your business.

Do I need a new phone number?+

You keep your existing business number. Unanswered calls route to the backup line through call forwarding. The exact setup depends on your phone provider.

Will callers know they’re speaking with AI?+

The assistant can introduce itself as your business’s AI assistant. The goal is a clear, helpful conversation that captures what the caller needs.

Can it make outbound calls?+

This offer is inbound only. NoringAI answers calls customers initiate. Your team handles any follow-up.

What happens when a question needs a person?+

The assistant follows the guidance you provide. When it can’t help, it collects the caller’s details and request so your team can take over.
